title: Bare SQLAlchemy attribute access at line 191 has no explanatory comment
detail: `aggregate._metadata` is accessed as a standalone expression after `context.session.expire(aggregate, ['_metadata'])` to force an immediate lazy-load while still inside the session. Without a comment this reads as dead code. The sibling files `host_mapping.py` (line 45) and `instance_mapping.py` (lines 134, 163) have an explanatory NOTE comment for the identical pattern; aggregate.py does not. Suggested fix: add a comment matching the pattern in those files.

title: 3 exception-chain breaks in aggregate.py (lines 81, 128, 233) lose original traceback
detail: Exceptions caught in `_host_add_to_db` (line 81), `_metadata_add_to_db` (line 128), and `_aggregate_create_in_db` (line 233) are re-raised as domain exceptions without `raise ... from exc`. This discards the original exception's traceback, making it harder to diagnose failures. Suggested fix: use `raise DomainException(...) from exc` at each site.
